explication: Source Code Pro is a distributable monospace font family, intended for user-interface environments. A consumer obtains the font assets and uses them in a UI; the repository provides static and variable font files in several formats, plus CSS files. The available excerpts establish the product and asset inventory, but do not show CSS-to-font mappings or other runtime wiring, so those relationships are not inferred.
